title: System Design Capstone: Designing & Building the CodeDev Learning Platform
concept: Design the CodeDev learning platform end to end and prove it works: requirements and estimates, architecture and data flow, a progress service without lost updates, a leaderboard projection, rate limits and backpressure, graceful degradation, recovery, a vertical slice that is idempotent end to end, and an architecture review.
description: An expert capstone that pulls the whole track together around one system: the CodeDev learning platform. Every lesson starts from a design question or an incident - two progress updates that overwrote each other, a cache outage that took the whole API down, a submission queue that grew until the graders fell over, a leaderboard lost with its cache, an architecture review board that asked for evidence - and answers it with code and numbers: requirements, capacity estimates, architecture and data flow, the progress service, an AI-written lost update, the leaderboard projection, per-user rate limits, backpressure, graceful degradation, a vertical slice from API to leaderboard, recovery, the Architecture Review Board scenario, failure modes, cost trade-offs and the design doc. 15 lessons with True/False quizzes on real designs and evidence, and TypeScript challenges graded by hidden tests on in-memory components.

learningOutcomes.text: Turn requirements and estimates into an architecture and data flow, and build a vertical slice of it
Update progress and projections without lost updates or double counting
Protect the platform with per-user rate limits and backpressure
Degrade gracefully, remove single points of failure and recover lost state
Defend design decisions with evidence, failure modes and costs in a review

knownIssues: Challenges run in-memory components with fake clocks; deploying the design is self-practice

lessons.title: The progress service: validation & monotonic updates
Spot the AI mistake: two progress updates that overwrite each other
A leaderboard projection from progress events
Graceful degradation: progress works when the leaderboard doesn't
A vertical slice: API to leaderboard, idempotent end to end
Recovery: rebuild the leaderboard after losing the cache
Architecture review board: a cache outage that took down the API
Failure modes & single points of failure
Cost trade-offs: what each component costs
